notes: Validated against Kim et al. PNAS 2020 (doi:10.1073/pnas.2006209117) and Greenlee et al. Cell Chem Biol 2022. 6WZS structure: F. ulcerans ZTP riboswitch bound to UG4 (5-amino-1-(pyridin-3-yl)-1H-imidazole-4-carboxamide, a synthetic ZTP analog without phosphate). UG4 binds via: pyridine ring π-stacking with G63; imidazole ring stacking on G17/G71. G63 2′-OH H-bonds the ligand. C69 N4 H-bonds the natural ligand ZMP; UG4 loses the ZMP phosphate-mediated H-bond to backbone, explaining ~2-fold lower affinity but maintained in vitro riboswitch activation. Mg²⁺ ions mediate some ligand-backbone contacts in 3.23 Å structure.
